    Selected split-basic idempotent corners #

    A finite injective subfamily of the chosen primitive idempotents of a split-basic algebra sums to an idempotent. Its corner inherits a chosen split-basic presentation, and its primitive-projective category identifies fully faithfully with the corresponding full subcategory of the ambient primitive-projective category.
